# Flat Submodule Worktree Creation Defect
Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3 repo cannot directly create a "flat submodule worktree" in this environment; must use parent worktree + nested submodule structure.

## Description
- Direct `git worktree add` inside the submodule repo (zhi2-web-admin) to a flat path makes git misjudge the toplevel as a common dir (.git/modules/...), showing all tracked files deleted; reproduces even with a pure ASCII path, while the nested structure works normally.
- Build config `rootDir = resolve(__dirname,"../")` couples output to the parent repo, so the submodule worktree must sit inside the parent root (e.g. `…\苏州市房地产监测V3\zhi2-web-admin-wt-6358`) for `../` to resolve and `dist/`+`env/` to land correctly.
- `node_modules` exists only in the parent root and `zhi2-web-admin/`; parent-root vite is 5.4.11 but the submodule declares 8.3.5, so an in-parent worktree must junction its `node_modules` to `zhi2-web-admin/node_modules` for correct vite 8.3.5.
- The main submodule `node_modules` can be wiped by parallel tasks (e.g. payfund/portal-skeleton worktree reinstall), breaking the junction and failing vite 8.3.5 (2026-11-09 session); `install.mjs` at parent `门户/scripts/install.mjs` only runs `npm install -f` at the parent root (vite 5.4.11) and cannot supply submodule vite 8.3.5.
- Reliable fix: remove the dead junction and run an independent `npm install` inside the worktree (vite locked 8.3.5, Node v22.23.2, no lockfile, no workspaces hoist); 834 packages installed, build passes, fully decoupled from the shared dir.

## Workflow
- Adopt the nested "parent repo worktree + submodule" pattern used by bug-6324/6326/6322 worktrees: from the parent repo run `git worktree add`, then init the inner zhi2-web-admin submodule and switch to the target branch.
- Base branch is `develop/v3.0.0`; concrete example `苏州市房地产监测V3-wt-bug-6372` uses a parent-level worktree with `node_modules` as a ReparsePoint (junction) to the main tree and the submodule on a matching branch; the same pattern was replicated for bug 6373.
- Verify with `git -C <wt> rev-parse --show-toplevel`; it must return the worktree root, not a .git/modules path.

## Removal Quirk
- `git worktree remove` refuses a worktree that contains a submodule checkout; even `git submodule deinit` (which clears files) still leaves the gitlink so git treats the submodule as present.
- Workaround: manually remove the worktree directory, then run `git worktree prune` to clear stale metadata; the shared submodule module dir and already-pushed commits stay safe.

## Encoding Quirk
- When git creates a worktree whose path contains the Chinese name `苏州市房地产监测V3`, it may write the `.git` file (and linked-worktree registration) with a mojibake/garbled encoding of that path; the worktree then can't resolve its gitdir and git falls back to treating the directory as a bare repo (hundreds of deletions + git internals shown as untracked). The registered worktree entry may still hold the correct Chinese path (2026-11-09 bug-6373 session). Note: console mojibake in PowerShell 5.1 is often just a GBK/UTF-8 display artifact (files are actually UTF-8); `git --git-dir=<worktree-gitdir> --work-tree=$wtSub status --short` returns correct results, proving git works when given the gitdir explicitly.
- Workaround attempted: rewrite the `.git` file with the correct UTF-8 path via Node (no BOM); the linked-worktree `commondir`/registration may also carry the encoding defect and need correction. Preferred fix: run all submodule git ops with explicit `--git-dir/--work-tree` to sidestep both the display artifact and in-tree `.git` pointer resolution; write commit messages via the `write` tool to a UTF-8 file and commit with `-F` to avoid PowerShell mangling Chinese.

## Relations
- Repos: Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3 (parent) + zhi2-web-admin (submodule)
- Source session: 2026-11-09 session (LpbStatisticsDialog fix pitfall, bug-6363 worktree removal, bug-6372/6373 pattern)
- bug-6373 result: submodule zhi2-web-admin @ d71a36607 on fix/bug-6373-preview-close (drag.js guard only, 4 insertions, version.json excluded as auto-generated); parent repo @ 05621b2 on same branch updating the gitlink.

# 扁平子模块 Worktree 创建缺陷
苏州房地产监测V3 仓库在本环境无法直接创建“扁平子模块 worktree”，须用父 worktree + 嵌套子模块结构。

## 描述
- 在子模块仓库(zhi2-web-admin)内直接 `git worktree add` 到扁平路径会使 git 误判顶层为公共目录(.git/modules/...)，显示所有跟踪文件被删；纯 ASCII 路径亦复现，嵌套结构正常。
- 构建配置 `rootDir = resolve(__dirname,"../")` 将输出耦合到父仓库，故子模块 worktree 须置于父根内(如 `…\苏州市房地产监测V3\zhi2-web-admin-wt-6358`)以便 `../` 解析且 `dist/`+`env/` 正确落位。
- `node_modules` 仅存在于父根与 `zhi2-web-admin/`；父根 vite 为 5.4.11 而子模块声明 8.3.5，故父内 worktree 须将其 `node_modules` junction 到 `zhi2-web-admin/node_modules` 以用正确 vite 8.3.5。
- 主子模块 `node_modules` 可被并行任务(如 payfund/portal-skeleton worktree 重装)清掉，破坏 junction 致 vite 8.3.5 失败(2026-11-09)；父 `门户/scripts/install.mjs` 仅跑父根 `npm install -f`(vite 5.4.11)，无法提供子模块 vite 8.3.5。
- 可靠修复：删死 junction 并在 worktree 内独立 `npm install`(vite 锁 8.3.5, Node v22.23.2, 无 lockfile, 无 workspaces hoist)；装 834 包，构建通过，完全脱离共享目录。

## 工作流
- 采用 bug-6324/6326/6322 worktree 使用的嵌套“父仓库 worktree + 子模块”模式：父仓库跑 `git worktree add`，再 init 内部 zhi2-web-admin 子模块并切目标分支。
- 基础分支 `develop/v3.0.0`；实例 `苏州市房地产监测V3-wt-bug-6372` 用父级 worktree，`node_modules` 为指向主树的 ReparsePoint(junction)，子模块在同名分支；bug 6373 复刻同模式。
- 验证 `git -C <wt> rev-parse --show-toplevel` 须返回 worktree 根，而非 .git/modules 路径。

## 移除怪癖
- `git worktree remove` 拒绝含子模块 checkout 的 worktree；即使 `git submodule deinit`(清文件)仍留 gitlink 致 git 认为子模块存在。
- 变通：手动删 worktree 目录后跑 `git worktree prune` 清陈旧元数据；共享子模块 module 目录与已推提交安全。

## 编码怪癖
- git 创建含中文名 `苏州市房地产监测V3` 路径的 worktree 时，可能将 `.git` 文件(及 linked-worktree 注册)写成乱码；worktree 无法解析 gitdir，git 退回将其当裸仓(大量删除+内部文件未跟踪)。注册项可能仍持正确中文路径(2026-11-09 bug-6373)。注：PowerShell 5.1 控制台乱码常仅为 GBK/UTF-8 显示假象(文件实 UTF-8)；`git --git-dir=<worktree-gitdir> --work-tree=$wtSub status --short` 结果正确。
- 尝试变通：用 Node(无 BOM)重写 `.git` 文件为正确 UTF-8；linked-worktree `commondir`/注册亦可能带编码缺陷需修正。首选：所有子模块 git 操作显式传 `--git-dir/--work-tree` 规避显示假象与树内 `.git` 指针解析；提交信息用 `write` 工具写 UTF-8 文件并以 `-F` 提交避免 PowerShell 破坏中文。

## 关系
- 仓库：苏州市房地产监测V3(父) + zhi2-web-admin(子模块)
- 来源会话：2026-11-09(LpbStatisticsDialog 修复坑、bug-6363 worktree 移除、bug-6372/6373 模式)
- bug-6373 结果：子模块 zhi2-web-admin @ d71a36607 于 fix/bug-6373-preview-close(仅 drag.js 防护, +4 行, version.json 因自动生成排除)；父仓库 @ 05621b2 同分支更新 gitlink。

# zhi2_web_admin
苏州市房地产监测V3的前端管理后台子模块仓库，承载预售与现售方案维护等页面。
## 描述
- 是父仓库“苏州市房地产监测V3”的 git 子模块，路径为 zhi2-web-admin。
- 基于 Vue 的前端 H5 管理项目，主分支 develop/v3.0.0。
## 相关页面
- 现售方案维护页：src/views/presale/cashsale/plan/detail.vue
- 预售方案页：src/views/presale/permit/plan/detail.vue
## 构建部署
- 使用 vite 8.3.5 构建，产物输出至父仓库 dist。
- 修复 bug6169 提交哈希 b1bb05685。
## 组件约束
- `zs-table` 内容溢出时进入 content-scroll 模式，将 `.el-table` 设为 `max-content` 变宽；`.list-card{overflow:hidden}` 会裁掉变宽部分及右侧固定「操作」列，故 `.zs-table-container--content-scroll` 需自行提供横向滚动，否则右侧「操作」列会被窗口右缘截断
- `index.scss` 的 `--content-scroll` 规则块已添加 `.zs-table-container--content-scroll{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden}`（bug-6358 修复），提供横向滚动使右侧固定「操作」列可达
- `v-dialogDrag` 指令曾吞掉 `el-dialog` 关闭按钮 click：`ImageViewer` 将 `:visible.sync` 绑定 store computed，X 按钮 click 被拖拽指令拦截无法关闭；`zs-dialog` 用相同指令但因 `visible` 为普通 data prop 正常关闭。已在 bug 6373 修复（提交 d71a36607）：drag.js 头部 `onmousedown` 内对 `.el-dialog__headerbtn` 直接 `return`，命中关闭按钮不重定位弹窗，保留其 `click`

- `v-dialogDrag` 指令曾吞掉 `el-dialog` 关闭按钮 click：`ImageViewer` 将 `:visible.sync` 绑定 store computed，X 按钮 click 被拖拽指令拦截无法关闭；`zs-dialog` 用相同指令但因 `visible` 为普通 data prop 正常关闭。已在 bug 6373 修复（提交 d71a36607）：drag.js 头部 `onmousedown` 内对 `.el-dialog__headerbtn` 直接 `return`，命中关闭按钮不重定位弹窗，保留其 `click`
